title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
ii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iii.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
iv.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back; each refresh, a city that never was.
